title: Moment connection at grid C-4 clashes with supply duct chase
question: The level 4 moment connection at grid C-4 runs into the main supply duct chase on M-301. Provide a revised connection detail.
answer: Use the revised detail on S-501R: four stiffener plates with field welds, connection rotated 90 degrees clear of the chase.

title: Curtain wall anchor embed spacing at level 3 slab edge
question: Embed plates at the level 3 slab edge are at 6 feet on center. Curtain wall mullions are at 5 feet. Confirm anchor locations.
answer: Add post-installed anchors at mullions between embeds per the detail on A-520. Keystone Concrete to confirm rebar clearance by scanning.

title: Sill flashing at level 1 storefront

title: Roof drain locations against tapered insulation
question: Roof drains RD-3 and RD-4 on P-401 do not sit at the low points of the tapered insulation layout. Which governs?
answer: The plumbing drain locations govern. Recut the tapered layout to the drains.

title: Stair 2 guardrail post embeds

title: Hydronic piping through level 2 shear wall
question: Two 4 inch hydronic pipes must pass through the level 2 shear wall at grid B-2. The structural drawings show no penetrations there. Provide sleeve locations or a reroute.

title: Exterior wall pack substitution
question: Specified Lumora exterior wall packs quote a 22 week lead time. Accept Halvard WP-40 as an equal, 5 week lead time?

title: Level 4 stack area slab flatness
question: The level 4 stack area tested FF 32 against a specified FF 35 for compact shelving. Is grinding the high spots acceptable?
answer: Grind high spots and retest. If the retest is below FF 33, apply a self-leveling underlayment under the compact shelving at Keystone Concrete's cost.
